exposure: placenta previa with or without placenta accreta spectrum disorders (PAS)
first-trimester serum pregnancy-associated plasma protein A (PAPP-A) multiples of the median (MoM) value
Control group (healthy pregnant women with previous cesarean section and normal placental location)
First-trimester serum pregnancy-associated plasma protein A (PAPP-A) multiples of the median (MoM) value
Patients with severe bleeding of 1,500 mL or more
outcome: Placenta previa with or without placenta accreta spectrum disorders (PAS)
cohort: 267 patients who had first-trimester screening test results for aneuploidy
finding: Elevated first-trimester serum PAPP-A MoM was significantly associated with placenta previa with PAS and the severity of bleeding.
